Hi Gaetan trolet,
Greetings of the Day
We reviewed the logs when error 54 occurred at outlet 1 (Chademo). We discovered that another vehicle was charging at CCS outlet (outlet 3), drawing approximately 60 kW. The power demand from the vehicle connected to outlet 1 exceeded the available power range at outlet 1, so the charging session didn't begin at this outlet.

Thank you for your patience, and we're looking forward to hearing from you soon.

additional_info.body:
Hi,
I would like to request some clarification regarding an issue with the charging station. The station is designed to deliver up to 300 kW, but when charging on connector 3 with 60 kW, it appears that connector 1 (Chademo) could not be used to charge another vehicle.
Could you confirm the power demand requested on connector 1 relative to the available power? I am surprised that a 60 kW charge on connector 3 could impact the ability to charge a vehicle via connector 1.
What steps can be taken to prevent this issue in the future?
Thank you in advance for your assistance and response.
Best regards,
